rows.grounds: compound of ratha and āruḍhā; feminine singular nominative agreeing with each attendant
compound of mahā, adbhuta, and parākramā; feminine singular nominative

items.question: What martial arrangement surrounds the goddess in this passage?
premises: Each attendant possesses great wonderful valor.
items.inference: The goddess is surrounded by individually chariot-mounted valorous attendants.
uncertainties: The exact number and identity of the attendants are not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Each one is mounted on a chariot and has great, wonderful valor.
